day: # Hymns for the Sundays and festivals of Lutheran Service Book (LCMS), kept with
# the day's readings (data/readings/lsb.csv: the same day, offset, cycle,
# variant and title, so each hymn joins its day's set) and listed apart from
#   kind hymn_lsb: the Hymn of the Day appointed by the LSB Hymn Selection Guide,
#     from LCMS Worship, "LSB Hymn of the Day, sorted by hymn number"
#     not days of the calendar (Mission Observance, Christian Education ...) are left out.
#   the other hymn_ kinds: LCMS Worship's yearly "Hymn Suggestions" for the
#     one-year series (2020-21 to 2025-26) and the three-year series (A 2022-23
#     pastor or cantor (tradition.csv hymn_credits), with the part of the service each hymn
#     is for (Entrance, Of the Day, Distribution, Closing, Offertory ...).
#     A list is a year's (`source`), and every list is kept every year: the page
#     shows a day the list of its own year, else the lists in turn (2026-27 the
#     2020-21 one-year list ...), and lists them all in a window.  A new year's

offset: and the turn takes it in.  Series C 2021-22

day: #     came in two parts by different hands: the second, from Pentecost on, is
#     "Series C 2021-22 (after Pentecost)".  A list printed again unchanged in a
#     later year (most of Series C 2024-25 is 2021-22's) is shown once, naming both
#     years.  Reformation Day and All Saints' Day have sets of readings for their
#     date and for the Sunday they are observed on: each list is given to all of them.
#     Alternatives printed "or" share a row.  A list's headings are matched to
#     the day by their dates; `service` is the heading as printed (Christmas
# Numbers are LSB's unless marked TLH (The Lutheran Hymnal, 1941), LW (Lutheran
# Worship, 1982), WS (Worship Supplement, 1969), ELH (Evangelical Lutheran Hymnary,
# 1996) or WH (Walther's Hymnal, 2012); a few parts are sung without a number
# (Psalm 22 chanted, the Litany).  Titles as printed, the one most lists use;
# "(st. 1, 8, 3)": the stanzas to sing.  The asterisks of the lists (where a
# list's Hymn of the Day is not the Guide's) are left out: the page shows the
# Guide's hymn beside it.  Good Friday's hymns in the Series C lists have no part
# Generated from the PDFs (pdfplumber, each column read apart), then checked:
# every list heading of each PDF found, and the hymn numbers of each PDF counted
# against the rows.  Mended in the reading: footnote marks run on to numbers and
# titles ("9778" is 977), a number broken over two lines (777/778), and one
# misprint (979 for 797, Praise the Almighty).  Corrections go here.
